name: L1 cell adhesion molecule

function.text: L1CAM encodes neural cell adhesion molecule L1. Annotated molecular activities include axon guidance receptor activity and protein domain specific binding. It participates in chemotaxis and axon development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to L1 syndrome (x-linked); X-linked hydrocephalus with stenosis of the aqueduct of Sylvius (x-linked). Additional curated associations are listed below.
